texts: good. the crowd is one group whose members are nightmoths, the gathering is recorded as that group acting as a unit rather than each moth separately, the lantern-row is its own thing filling the place slot, and both coined compounds keep their plain heads (moth, row).

good. "the sky-cats" binds a group of sky-cats and the question asks openly what that group does, which is the supported shape for an open "what do they do" question. Just make sure the facts meant to answer it also present the sky-cats as a group — a fact about a single sky-cat acting alone is not reached by this question.
